snippet.title: Ismene - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3443990/Ismene

The story of Ismene, floating through space with her trusted robot companion, trying to figure out where she is going, and where she came from. An adventure game for Windows, Mac and Linux, coming 2027.

Public domain music: Excerpt from "In The Steppes of Central Asia" from European Archive (https://musopen.org/music/681-in-the-steppes-of-central-asia/)
